evidence.note: Header bar, green section kicker, serif title and Notes button sit in the same place and style on every slide; no element collides at any step shown.
Paired Q2/Q3 bar chart with labelled values and a 90% target line is the deck's strongest, purposeful visual; step 3 dims it under a well-placed Insight tile.
Two-cause node diagram with a DISPUTED label and caption is clean and builds clearly.
The roadworks 'timeline' is a small left-hand numbered list in small text; the right half and lower third of the slide stay empty apart from a quote tile.
Measures slide is three thin text columns with no visual, leaving most of the slide blank.
Summary cards hold very small bullet text with a large empty gap between title and cards.
Close slide is a numbered question list filling the left third; the right two-thirds are empty.

rationale: Styling, chrome and components are consistent and nothing collides, so the deck clears levels 1-2. Only s-4 and s-7 carry purposeful diagrams; s-3, s-6 and s-8 are text-led and sparse, with the s-6 timeline in particular failing to become a diagram, which keeps the deck below the reference bar. That fits level 3: consistent and clean, but generic, with diagrams not yet filling their purpose.
